title: Grateful Dead Live at Golden Hall, Community Concourse on 1982-02-20
lineage: Nak DR1 EQ Type II, Dolby B On > Sony PCMR500 DAT deck SBM On > Monster Digital Coax Cable >Turtle Beach Montego II Digital I/O card > PC (CDWav used to record and break up tracks)
source: Audience Recording: 6th row center:  Sony ECM 220T mics on hats > Sony TCDM5 Cassette tape on Sony FeCr Type III tapes with Dolby B

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear, Jerry‑forward audience capture of an above‑average show with a smoking second set and standout Franklin’s > Sampson.
ai_review.review: The recording is unusually clear but heavily weighted toward Jerry's guitar, giving the mix a front‑row feel while other instruments sit farther back. Musically the concert is solid – the first set is decent and the second set “smokes,” highlighted by a fiery Franklin’s > Sampson and an exciting Brent keyboard jam, though the closing trio of R&R, One More Saturday Night and Brokedown Palace dampens the finish. Overall the show’s energy is high and the audio, while imbalanced, remains listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: Five detailed reviews with an average of 4.4 stars; most praise the performance and clarity despite mix quirks, yielding a strong combined show‑and‑recording score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear overall but heavily front‑loaded on Jerry's guitar; bass and other instruments sound distant early in the set, improving as the show progresses. The mix feels split‑personality – almost like a close mic on Jerry with audience ambience for the rest.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set solid but unremarkable; second set builds momentum and delivers the high points, though the final three songs feel like a let‑down.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Front‑and‑center guitar work described as "resplendent," "insane," and "balls‑to‑the‑walls"; dominates the mix and lifts every song.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's brief jam with the drums is highlighted as a cool, messy moment; praised for adding texture.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drummers noted in Brent's jam but no specific evaluation of Bill or Mickey beyond that context.
